checks.summary: A6 and A7, PASSED. The payload is derived from a REAL commit: the real git binary at a resolved absolute path builds a bare origin in t.TempDir(), the adapter clones it inside a REAL rootless user+mount namespace, writes three paths (plain text, a nested path and bytes that are not valid UTF-8), one is chmod-ed executable and restaged, the adapter commits and VerifyIntegrity measures the head tree. PublicationPayload then uses only already-allowlisted subcommands -- diff --name-only base head, ls-files --stage -- path, cat-file -s, cat-file blob and rev-parse -- each carrying -C with the absolute working copy root and each confined exactly as V2-071's children are. MEASURED: the derived mode and blob object name equal what the local repository reports for the same path for all three paths, two at 100644 and one at 100755; the decoded base64 content equals the bytes in the working copy including the non-UTF-8 path; the derived head tree equals IntegrityObservation.TreeName; the derived base tree equals the local rev-parse of the base commit's tree. Three refusals are measured against real fixtures: a symlink entry at mode 120000 and a submodule gitlink at mode 160000 are each ErrPublicationModeUnrepresentable, a deletion is ErrPublicationDeletionUnrepresentable, and base equal to head is ErrPublicationChangeSetEmpty. The gitlink fixture also re-asserts that update-index is NOT constructible through the adapter. No git fixture, pack file or bare directory was committed.

checks.name: argv-and-bodies-field-by-field
checks.summary: A5 and A8, PASSED. The closed operation list has exactly SEVEN entries -- four writes (create blob, create tree, create commit, create ref), two reads (read ref, read commit) and one measurement read (the workflow-run count for a branch) -- read from exactly one place by one reader. Every write is POST with a body and every read is GET without one; no entry uses PATCH, PUT or DELETE. Positive controls: update-ref, delete-ref, force-ref, patch-ref, create-pull-request, create-tag, create-release and the empty operation each resolve to no spec and no argv is constructible for any of them. All seven argv are asserted ELEMENT BY ELEMENT against the resolved absolute executable, with --method stated explicitly so the argv itself witnesses what the call does, the repository path built from validated single-segment owner and name, and --input - on every write so the body travels on standard input and never in argv. Seven malformed coordinates are refused with ErrForgeCoordinateInvalid, a missing or option-shaped path argument is refused, and a stray argument on a body-only operation is refused. All four bodies are asserted FIELD BY FIELD: blob is exactly content+encoding=base64; tree is base_tree=the base commit's tree plus one entry per changed path with path, mode, type=blob and sha; commit is message+tree+parents with EXACTLY ONE parent, the base commit; ref is ref+sha. The key sets are asserted exhaustively and NO key named force appears in any of the four -- there is no map-shaped body anywhere in the adapter, so the set of keys a body can carry is the set of declared struct fields. A ref outside the reserved prefix is refused by RefBody and by PublicationCommitMessage, an unrepresentable mode never reaches a tree body, and an empty tree body cannot be built.

checks.name: all-refusal-paths

Executable refusals, all before any process could exist and with an injectable stat hook so each is deterministic: a non-absolute path, a basename that is not the expected tool, a missing file, a path that stats to a directory and a non-empty granted set; in every case no argv is constructible either. The child environment is EXACTLY HOME and PATH, built through the same construction internal/runner/forge.go uses and passed through GuardEnvironment and GuardCommand; a non-empty granted set refuses to build one; no environment entry is credential-shaped. The git child, separately re-asserted, still receives no HOME and HOME is still absent from the git environment allowlist. Every one of the four target disagreements plus a missing stored target refuses with ZERO transport calls, and so do the five source-side refusals and the two payload disagreements, and a delivery whose ref is outside the reserved prefix, and an unconfigured publisher. A10: seven distinct failure paths are constructed with a transport whose output and error both carry a marker string, and no error returned by Deliver or Observe contains the marker or any workspace path, on any of them -- the injected transport's error is reduced to this adapter's own sentinel exactly as the real child's is, so the property is structural rather than a property of the real transport only. Standard error is discarded outright, standard output is bounded by a hard byte cap, and no HTTP status or error body is parsed anywhere.

checks.name: four-content-addressed-equalities
checks.summary: A9 and A11, PASSED. Confirmation requires all four equalities and each is asserted: every blob object name the forge returns equals the local object name from ls-files --stage, the created tree object name equals the locally verified head tree, the ref's commit's tree equals that same local head tree and its parent list is exactly the one base commit, and the ref read back is the ref this operation intended. A deliberate violation of EACH ONE INDIVIDUALLY is refused rather than confirmed: a disagreeing blob name is ErrForgeBlobDisagrees, a disagreeing created tree is ErrForgeTreeDisagrees, a disagreeing commit tree and a two-entry parent list are both ErrForgeCommitDisagrees, and a read-back that names another ref makes this ref absent after the write, which is undecidable rather than confirmed. The local commit object name and the published commit object name are BOTH RECORDED and their agreement is measured and logged but NOT required, because the forge constructs the commit object and requiring equality would assert an unmeasured fact about another system's encoding. The three outcomes: absent-then-created confirms; already present with the intended tree converges with ZERO write calls; present with a different tree is undecidable and records ref-disagrees with the agreement flag clear. The observer answers only from reads: absent is not-observed, present-and-agreeing is confirmed, and an unreadable ref returns an error so the item stays ambiguous for the next pass rather than becoming a permanent needs-input.

checks.name: six-elements-through-the-real-dispatcher
checks.summary: A20, PASSED, seven subtests. The dispatcher is the REAL application.OutboxDispatcher, the store is the REAL internal/store/memory adapter, the command is the REAL Service.PublishChange, the sink and the observer are the REAL ForgePublisher, and the source is the REAL GitSourceControl reading a REAL commit made by the real git binary inside a REAL namespace from a local bare origin. The ONLY injection is the transport, and it is a FUNCTION -- not a process, not a fake dispatcher and not a fake store. The six elements of domain-model.md section 9 are all exercised: operation_id minted once by the command and reused verbatim as the IdempotencyKey; target as the registered Repository plus the full ref; expected version as both the Execution's domain Version in the item and the external state 'ref absent'; the fencing token minted by effectOutbox, revalidated by beforeEffect and revalidated a third time by the adapter's own pre-write target re-read; the outbox created in the same transaction as the event; and the read-after-write wired as DispatcherConfig.Observer. Four outcomes measured as separate subtests: created and confirmed (status delivered, Observation published-and-observed, blob count equal to the changed-path count, no body carrying a force key); already present and convergent ACROSS TWO REAL ATTEMPTS (the first attempt fails retryably, the injected clock is advanced two seconds past the retry instant -- deliberately not two minutes, which would expire the Lease and yield superseded instead -- and the second attempt converges with ZERO additional write calls, and both attempts carried the identical operation identifier AND idempotency key, equal to the one the command minted); present and disagreeing (ambiguous on the first pass with zero write calls, then needs-input with observation unknown on the second, Observation ref-disagrees); and an unknown outcome reaching ambiguous then read-after-write, confirmed in one case and needs-input in the other. A stale fence yields superseded with ZERO transport calls, and a ScopeRepository Control Intent denying external effects prevents delivery with ZERO transport calls.
